method.description: The backend method used to request shutdown/reboot/suspend/hibernate. Options: auto, gnome_session, kde_session, hal, consolekit, devicekit, upower, shutdown.

countdown_minutes.description: The duration in minutes for the shutdown countdown. Maximum allowed value is 1440 (24 hours).

action.description: The action to perform after the countdown expires. Options: shutdown, reboot, suspend, hibernate.

lock_all.description: If true, enables 'parental lock' for every user. Requires qshutdown to be started once by root and sudoers entry for /usr/bin/qshutdown.

password.description: Password required to edit the config file or restrict access. Leave empty for no password.

warnings_on.description: If true, qshutdown shows itself 3 times as a warning if there are less than 70 seconds left.

autostart_script.description: Path to the X session autostart script used when lock_all is enabled.
